A bill for an act relating to state government; appropriating money for additional attorneys in the Office of the Attorney General.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION. +]

[+$1,602,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the Office of the Attorney General to hire six additional attorneys. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to state government; appropriating money for additional attorneys in the Office of the Attorney General.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION.

$1,602,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the Office of the Attorney General to hire six additional attorneys.
additions: $1,602,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the Office of the Attorney General to hire six additional attorneys.
